systems.country_label: Centralised Digital Platform / SHA digital platform
systems.tiers: all providers seeking a contract under the four SHA funds; used for onboarding and claims

systems.system: Facility electronic medical records system or other approved claims system
systems.tiers: required of contracted facilities, primary healthcare providers included, from the cycle opening 1 October 2026

note: States a contracting requirement, not a deployment: facilities must have a functional electronic medical records system 'or another approved claims system' to support contracting and claims processing, with internet-enabled devices at points of service. The requirement is framed by claims, names no system and gives no count of facilities holding one, so no fact.
